unit-roles.bin.gz.meaning: red template roles: 1 main, 2 shade, 3 light, 4 flag rim

units.bin.gz.meaning: palette index, 255 transparent; 0-179 red side, 180-359 blue side; a unit = pieces 2k (top) and 2k+1 (bottom)

hashes.composedSha256: sha256 of the composed canvas (uint8 palette index, 255 empty, canvas size)
hashes.terrainSha256: sha256 of 4096 ASCII letters recordClass[tileset][record id], cells in row-major order (r = 0..63, then c = 0..63), no separators — the same letters as catalog-v1.json terrainRows joined

layout.order: layer 0 for every cell, then layer 1, …; within a layer sort by (r - c, r + c)
layout.project: x = (r + c) * 16, y = (r - c) * 8 + side * 8 + top - layer * step
layout.record: 8 bytes: [layer count, piece id for layers 0..6]; piece 0 = none; layer count is not used for drawing

structures.note: gate open/closed/broken, wall durability and ladder record ids are not identified yet
